sin.name: plain-viewer-text
sin.description: Text shown on a viewer page speaks as the app or uses an internal word.
sin.rule: Write every text a person reads in plain, ordinary words: name who acts ('the agent', 'the journal'), say what a control does, and use the house words (Close, Pause, item, to-do). A heading names what is chosen and never ends in a preposition; an option finishes its heading's sentence.
